comparisons.peer_summary: The company aims to deliver open software and hardware platforms based on industry standards, having historically contributed to standards such as CXL, Thunderbolt, and PCI Express, as well as supporting open-source products like Linux and Android.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel discuss the strategic importance of open standards and software ecosystems in their embedded and general product strategies. AMD highlights that the embedded market has shifted toward industry-standard instruction set architectures to reduce costs and speed time to market, noting the critical need for support for operating systems like Linux and Windows. Similarly, Intel states its aim to deliver open software and hardware platforms based on industry standards, citing historic contributions to standards like CXL, Thunderbolt, and PCI Express, as well as contributions to open-source products like Linux and Android. While AMD focuses on the market trend driving adoption of standards for efficiency, Intel focuses on its active role in defining those standards.

sentences.text: Support for Linux®, Windows® and other operating systems as well as for increasingly sophisticated applications are also critical for some customers.

The embedded market has moved from developing proprietary, custom designs to leveraging industry-standard instruction set architectures and processors as a way to help reduce costs and speed time to market.
We aim to deliver open software and hardware platforms with industry-defining standards.
We also contributed to the design, build, and validation of open-source products in the industry such as Linux, Android, and others.

comparisons.peer_topic: Intellectual property portfolio and technology scope
comparisons.peer_summary: The company owns significant IP in CDMA/OFDMA technologies and develops other key technologies including video/audio codecs, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AI, machine learning, and RF/RFFE designs, some of which become industry standards.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Qualcomm disclose the development and contribution of technologies that become industry standards. AMD notes that the embedded market has moved toward leveraging industry-standard instruction set architectures to reduce costs and speed time to market. Qualcomm similarly states that it develops key technologies, some of which are contributed to and commercialized as industry standards, such as for video and audio codecs, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. Both companies frame their involvement in standard-setting as a core part of their technology and business strategy.
